robots.off: Half of its spinning bar snaps.
robots.shows: A short ragged half bar.
robots.fight: Spins faster, reaches less far: quick small hits.

robots.shows: A thin bare steel flipper.
robots.fight: Weaker flips, and the flipper bends a bit more with every flip.

robots.shows: An empty crane.
robots.fight: Nothing to drop; small bricks lie around; it shoves with its dozer blade.

robots.shows: A bare gold flywheel.
robots.fight: Lighter and faster but out of true: soft hits.

robots.shows: Two rails peeled apart.
robots.fight: Still fires, but wide (up to 17°).

robots.off: The hopper cracks open, its junk pours out.
robots.shows: A cracked, empty hopper.
robots.fight: Starts collecting from zero; can't eat its own spilled junk.

robots.shows: Its brain: a wheel of six tools.
robots.fight: Picks a tool at random instead of choosing.

robots.off: A strip of hull: the hull splits.
robots.shows: The winch drum and rope in the gap.
robots.fight: Reels in at half speed; spinners and saws can cut the rope.

robots.shows: No crate, a bent loader arm.
robots.fight: Must drive right up to a record before it can throw again.

robots.off: The spring casing bursts; the spring uncoils on the floor.
robots.shows: An empty socket, a stub of spring.
robots.fight: Only short weak hops from close in; the spring bounces whoever drives into it.

robots.shows: A glowing open forge.
robots.fight: Burns whoever touches it, but overheats and pauses hammering.

robots.shows: An empty coil bay, a thin bare core.
robots.fight: Pulls half as hard; the loose wire tangles wheels.

robots.off: The spear tip breaks off (it can stay stuck in the other robot).
robots.shows: A jagged broken shaft.
robots.fight: Pierces a little; a lunge that lands bashes; a stuck tip stings.

robots.off: Up to three legs, one side.
robots.shows: Thick glowing stumps.
robots.fight: Limps, then turns in circles, then drags.

robots.shows: Sparking stumps.
robots.fight: Strikes less often; stumps zap whoever touches them.

robots.shows: The little engine that drives the lift.
robots.fight: Flicks robots off its forks instead of carrying them.

robots.off: One grinder disc flies off, still spinning.
robots.shows: A bare spindle, gear and torn belt.
robots.fight: One grinder, faster, comes in crabwise; the loose disc bites.

robots.shows: A bare torn pole.
robots.fight: Waits, then swats hard: the torn end rakes and spins the robot away.

robots.off: The cover over its ram pops, the hose splits.
robots.shows: The red ram and a split hose.
robots.fight: Chomps instead of holding; spits small oil puddles.

robots.off: The axe head flies into the floor.
robots.shows: The jagged broken handle.
robots.fight: Quick short stabs that go through armour.

robots.off: The chain snaps, the ball rolls on.
robots.shows: A short broken chain end.
robots.fight: Lassos robots, drags them round and flings them (it tears at them).

robots.shows: A smooth hex bar.
robots.fight: Can't anchor: pins robots on the wall and rubs them hot.

robots.off: The spiked ball shell cracks in two.
robots.shows: A long whip chain.
robots.fight: Hangs back and lashes; the half shells puncture tyres.

robots.off: The whole tail drops off like a lizard's.
robots.shows: A short stinger at the tail root.
robots.fight: Stops spinning, reverses into robots stinger first.

robots.shows: The tipped disc's face.
robots.fight: Throws robots sideways and spins them, no air time.

robots.shows: A bare reel gear, broken pawl.
robots.fight: Gaffs any side and trawls robots off behind it.

robots.shows: A scorched hole, the bare axle.
robots.fight: The arms slap in turn instead of squeezing.

robots.shows: The bare drum, the cable in slack loops, a snapped brake band.
robots.fight: Can't reel in: throws the saw free and drives over to pick it up.

robots.shows: The turret ring gear and a magazine of spare bolas.
robots.fight: Stops and turns its nose on the robot to flick bolas, short and slow.

robots.shows: A bare drum of steel cable, torn rubber ends.
robots.fight: No wind-up: winches itself straight down the cable into the robot.

robots.off: The rotor lock cap shears off.
robots.shows: A bare hub: broken lock teeth, a sparking slip ring.
robots.fight: Can't dock its blades: always spinning, slower, on short tethers.

robots.off: The twin fuel tanks tear out.
robots.shows: An empty cradle, a fuel pump, a burning fuel line.
robots.fight: No flame at the nose; leaves a burning trail and drags robots through it.

robots.off: The throwing arm snaps at the pivot.
robots.shows: The jagged arm stump and the gas ram.
robots.fight: Runs scooped robots into the nearest wall like a wheelbarrow and dumps them.

rules.t: How much should losing a piece hurt?
rules.d: Now most robots win about as often with the new model as without it. Only Bricklayer and Pogo clearly lose out.

rules.t: How often should pieces come off?
rules.d: Now in 35 to 65 fights out of 100, depending on the robot.

rules.t: New parts on Angler, Pincher and Hydra
rules.d: Angler's reel, Pincher's gears and Hydra's side heads did not exist before: they were added so there was something to lose.
